info.title: ShelfLife API
info.description:
Backend API for ShelfLife.

All endpoints share a global rate limit of 150 requests/minute per client; every `/api/v1/auth/*` endpoint additionally enforces a 5 requests/minute limit (429), and every authenticated endpoint enforces a 60 requests/minute limit keyed by user id (429). POST bodies are size-limited (413 when exceeded) and requests time out server-side (504). Error bodies, where present, use the `ErrorResponse` shape; `error` is a machine-readable code.

Sorting, grouping, and aggregation of pantry data are frontend concerns, not this API's — endpoints return raw data (in insertion order for lists) and let the client format it.

get.description: Returns health status of the service including database connectivity

post.description: Creates a user account and sends a verification email. Supports idempotent retries via the optional `Idempotency-Key` header: a replayed key with the same payload returns the original response (with `X-Idempotency-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different payload returns 422; a concurrent in-flight request with the same key returns 409 `REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS`.

password.description: Must contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one digit.

name.description: No leading/trailing spaces; must not contain < > " ' & ;

201.description: User registered; response body is empty

400.description: Validation failed (`VALIDATION_FAILED`), weak password (`WEAK_PASSWORD`), invalid email (`INVALID_EMAIL`), or invalid idempotency key (`INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY`)

409.description: Email already registered (`ALREADY_EXISTS`) or an identical idempotent request is in flight (`REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS`)

422.description: Idempotency key reused with a different payload (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_PAYLOAD`)

post.description: Authenticate and receive access + refresh tokens

401.description: Invalid credentials; response body is empty

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (empty body), or account temporarily locked after repeated failed logins (`ACCOUNT_LOCKED`)

post.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a new token pair; the refresh token is rotated on each use. Reusing an already-rotated token invalidates the whole token family (theft detection).

401.description: Invalid/expired refresh token (empty body), or reuse of a rotated token (`TOKEN_REUSE_DETECTED` — the entire token family is now invalidated)

get.description: Consumes an email verification token; response bodies on success are empty

200.description: Email verified; response body is empty

post.description: Always responds 200 regardless of whether the email is registered, to avoid leaking account existence. Emits a reset email only if the account exists.

200.description: Request accepted (whether or not the account exists)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded, or account temporarily locked (`ACCOUNT_LOCKED`)

post.description: Checks whether a reset token is still usable, without consuming it.
Consumes the reset token and sets a new password.

newPassword.description: Must contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one digit; must differ from the current password (`SAME_AS_OLD` otherwise).

429.description: Rate limit exceeded, or account temporarily locked (`ACCOUNT_LOCKED`)

200.description: Logged out; response body is empty

post.description: Invalidates all refresh tokens for the authenticated user

200.description: All sessions ended; response body is empty

post.description: Sends a new verification email to the authenticated user. No request body.

200.description: Verification email sent; response body is empty

500.description: Verification token could not be issued (`INVALID_TOKEN`/`EXPIRED_TOKEN`)

get.description: Returns global products together with the caller's own private products, matching `q` case-insensitively. An empty/missing `q` returns an empty list — this is autocomplete, not a listing endpoint (use `GET /products/mine` for that).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text; defaults to empty (which returns an empty list)

200.description: Matching products, global and the caller's own

get.summary: List the caller's own private products
get.description: All of the caller's own private products, no query needed — for a "manage my products, rename them" screen. Never includes global products.

post.description: Creates a product owned by the caller. Rejected if the (trimmed, case-insensitive) name collides with a global product or one of the caller's own. Supports idempotent retries the same way as `/auth/register` (see that endpoint's description).

409.description: Name collides with a global product or one of the caller's own (`DUPLICATE_NAME`), or an identical idempotent request is in flight (`REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS`)

422.description: Idempotency key reused with a different payload (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_PAYLOAD`)

patch.description: Only the owner of a private product may rename it; global products can never be renamed via this endpoint (`NOT_FOUND` either way — a caller never learns whether `id` is someone else's product or a global one).

400.description: Validation failed (`VALIDATION_FAILED`), or `id` is not a valid integer (`INVALID_PRODUCT_ID`)

404.description: Not the caller's private product, or doesn't exist (`NOT_FOUND`)

409.description: New name collides with a global product or one of the caller's own (`DUPLICATE_NAME`)

post.description: Names are unique per caller (case-sensitive). Supports idempotent retries the same way as `/auth/register`.

409.description: Name already used by the caller (`DUPLICATE_NAME`), or an identical idempotent request is in flight (`REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS`)

422.description: Idempotency key reused with a different payload (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_PAYLOAD`)

patch.description: Only the owner may rename it — a caller never learns whether `id` belongs to another user or doesn't exist (`NOT_FOUND` either way).

400.description: Validation failed (`VALIDATION_FAILED`), or `id` is not a valid integer (`INVALID_LOCATION_ID`)

404.description: Not the caller's storage location, or doesn't exist (`NOT_FOUND`)

409.description: New name already used by the caller (`DUPLICATE_NAME`)

delete.description: Pantry entries referencing this location are unaffected — `storageLocationId` on a `pantry_entries` row simply becomes invalid to re-set, it is not cascaded.

404.description: Not the caller's storage location, or doesn't exist (`NOT_FOUND`)

get.description: A small, fully-seeded closed set (grams, kilograms, millilitres, litres, pieces, ...). Never created or edited via the API.

Cursor-paginated, in insertion order (`id` ascending) — sorting, grouping, and aggregation for display are entirely a frontend concern. Pass `afterId` (the previous page's `nextCursor`) to fetch the next page; `nextCursor` is `null` on the last page. A non-numeric `afterId` is treated as absent (start from the beginning), not an error.

parameters.name: afterId
parameters.description: Resume after this entry id; omit to start from the beginning

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size; clamped to [1, 200], defaults to 50

post.summary: Log a purchase (create a pantry entry)
post.description: Exactly one of `productId` (an existing product the caller can see) or `newProductName` (create a private product inline, in the same transaction — the "typed a name, autocomplete found nothing, add it anyway" flow) must be provided. Always inserts a new row, even if one already matches exactly (buying more of something already in stock is not a merge). Supports idempotent retries the same way as `/auth/register`.

400.description: Validation failed (`VALIDATION_FAILED`), `productId` isn't visible to the caller (`PRODUCT_NOT_VISIBLE`), `storageLocationId` isn't the caller's (`STORAGE_LOCATION_NOT_FOUND`), or `unitId` doesn't exist (`UNIT_NOT_FOUND`)

409.description: `newProductName` collides with a global product or one of the caller's own (`PRODUCT_NAME_ALREADY_EXISTS`), or an identical idempotent request is in flight (`REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS`)

422.description: Idempotency key reused with a different payload (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_PAYLOAD`)

patch.description: Full-state replace, not a sparse delta — resend every editable field, including ones you aren't changing. `quantityAmount <= 0` deletes the row instead of updating it (200 with the updated entry, or 204 if deleted).

204.description: Entry deleted (quantity was zero or negative)

400.description: Validation failed (`VALIDATION_FAILED`), `id` is not a valid integer (`INVALID_ENTRY_ID`), `storageLocationId` isn't the caller's (`STORAGE_LOCATION_NOT_FOUND`), or `unitId` doesn't exist (`UNIT_NOT_FOUND`)

404.description: Not the caller's pantry entry, or doesn't exist (`NOT_FOUND`)

message.example: Password reset successfully. You can now log in.

isGlobal.description: true if this product ships with the app and is visible to every user; false if it's private to its owner

defaultLifespanDays.description: Pre-fill hint for a new pantry entry's expiration date; not enforced server-side

defaultUnitCategory.description: Pre-fill hint for a new pantry entry's unit; not enforced server-side

productName.description: Denormalized at read time via a join — always current, never cached on the row

items.description: In insertion order (id ascending) — sorting/grouping for display is a frontend concern

nextCursor.description: Pass as `afterId` to fetch the next page; null when this is the last page

newProductName.description: Creates a private product inline, in the same transaction — exactly one of productId/newProductName is required

storageLocationId.description: Must be one of the caller's own storage locations

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid JWT access token; response body is empty

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded (auth endpoints: 5 requests/minute; authenticated endpoints: 60 requests/minute per user); response body is empty
